content.title: Portland Trail Blazers vs. Minnesota Timberwolves: How to watch streaming live, game preview, odds
content.text: Portland Trail BlazersPublished: Mar. 20, 2026, 10:05 a.m.The Portland Trail Blazers visit Julius Randle and the Minnesota Timberwolves on Friday night. (AP Photo/Matt Krohn)APBy Joe Freeman | The Oregonian/OregonLiveThe Portland Trail Blazers play the Minnesota Timberwolves on Friday in an NBA matchup at Target Center.Here are the details:PORTLAND TRAIL BLAZERS (34-36) vs. MINNESOTA TIMBERWOLVES (43-27)When: 5 p.m., Friday, March 20Where: Target Center, MinneapolisRadio: Rip City Radio (KPOJ 620 AM).TV channel: KUNP (Antenna: 47.1. Xfinity: 16, 302, 1170. DirecTV: 47. Spectrum: 184).Online: Seventy-six of the Blazers’ 82 games this season can be streamed live or on-demand via BlazerVision for an annual fee of $120. For more information about Rip City TV and how to watch Blazers games, visit nba.com/blazers/watchBlazers introduce Tom Dundon: New owner on NBA players, being liked, staying in Portland, making a big splashTrail Blazers vs Pelicans live stream tonight: How to watch with free viewing optionsNew Trail Blazers owner Tom Dundon says ‘hard work is enjoyed’ — and Portland is about to find out whyPortland Trail Blazers vs. New Orleans Pelicans: How to watch streaming live, game preview, oddsNBA fines Trail Blazers $100,000 and suspends 2 assistant GMs for Yang Hansen draft violation ODDS (Oregon Lottery/DraftKings)Moneyline: MIN -135 POR +114Spread: MIN -2.5 | Over/Under: 231.5This and that: The Blazers bring a modest two-game winning streak into the matchup after earning victories over two of the worst teams (Brooklyn and Indiana) in the NBA. The wins, combined with the recent struggles of the Los Angeles Clippers and Golden State Warriors, have catapulted the Blazers up the Western Conference standings into a tie with the Clippers for eighth place. ... Los Angeles does not play tonight, so a win would move the Blazers into sole possession of eighth place. ... Portland defeated the last-placed Pacers 127-119 Wednesday night in Indianapolis, building a 22-point fourth-quarter lead before holding on down the stretch. ... Donovan Clingan finished with a career-high 28 points while adding 13 rebounds, two blocks and two assists, and Deni Avdija added 32 points, 11 rebounds and five assists. ... This is the fourth game of a five-game trip for the Blazers, who close with a visit to the Denver Nuggets on Sunday. ... Minnesota All-Star Anthony Edwards has missed the last two games with right knee inflammation. Even so, the Timberwolves won both matchups, defeating the Phoenix Suns (116-104) and Utah Jazz (147-111) at home. ... Minnesota has won three of four games over the last week, settling into fourth place in the Western Conference. ... The Timberwolves are 24-12 at home this season. ... This is the fourth and final meeting between the teams this season and Minnesota is seeking a series-sweep. The Timberwolves defeated the Blazers by a combined seven points in two meetings in Portland and routed the Blazers by 24 points in a February matchup in Minneapolis.INJURIESPortland: Vit Krejci (left calf bruise) is questionable and Shaedon Sharpe (left calf strain/fibula injury) and Damian Lillard (left Achilles tendon) are out.Minnesota: Anthony Edwards (right knee inflammation) is out and Naz Reid (right ankle sprain) is questionable. NEXT UPThe Blazers play the Denver Nuggets on Sunday at 2 p.m. at Ball Arena.Joe Freeman is a senior writer at The Oregonian/OregonLive, who covers the Portland Trail Blazers and the NBA.
